name: My life is now a fanfiction?!
source:
How many romance tropes can we fit into the story? An anti-romantic main character ends up having their life magically shifted toward love.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
我们究竟能往一个故事里塞进多少恋爱桥段？一位对恋爱敬谢不敏的主角，人生竟被魔法强行扭向了浪漫恋曲的轨道。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
